def range_compress(sequence):
    if not sequence:
        return []
    sorted_vals = sorted(set(sequence))
    result = []
    start = sorted_vals[0]
    prev = start
    for val in sorted_vals[1:]:
        if val == prev + 1:
            prev = val
        else:
            result.append([start, prev])
            start = val
            prev = val
    result.append([start, prev])
    return result

def range_compress(values):
    if not values:
        return []
    unique = sorted(set(values))
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(unique)
    while i < n:
        start = unique[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and unique[j] == unique[j - 1] + 1:
            j += 1
        end = unique[j - 1]
        if start == end:
            result.append([start])
        else:
            result.append([start, end])
        i = j
    return result

def range_compress(seq):
    if not seq:
        return []
    uniq = sorted(set(seq))
    res = []
    i = 0
    n = len(uniq)
    while i < n:
        start = uniq[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and uniq[j] == uniq[j - 1] + 1:
            j += 1
        end = uniq[j - 1]
        if j - i > 2:
            res.append([start, end])
        else:
            res.append([start] * (j - i))
        i = j
    return res
